title: AIR Plugin Manifest
description: The body of a single AIR plugin, stored at <plugin-dir>/.plugin/plugin.json and referenced by `path` from a plugins.json index entry. This is AIR's vendor-neutral analog of the Open Plugins `.plugin/plugin.json` manifest: it carries the plugin's bundled artifact references (skills, mcp_servers, hooks, plugins) and distribution metadata. Unlike Open Plugins, the component fields hold AIR artifact IDs (references into skills.json / mcp.json / hooks.json indexes) rather than paths to bundled component directories. The owning plugins.json entry remains a lightweight registry (description + path + default_in_roots); fields it declares inline take precedence over this manifest.

name.description: Plugin identifier. Optional and informational — the authoritative ID is the key of the plugins.json entry that references this manifest. Included for Open Plugins compatibility.

title.description: Human-readable display name for the plugin.

description.description: Concise description of what this plugin provides. The plugins.json index entry's description takes precedence when both are present.

skills.description: IDs of skills bundled by this plugin. Must reference skill IDs defined in skills.json indexes.

mcp_servers.description: IDs of MCP servers bundled by this plugin. Must reference server IDs defined in mcp.json indexes.

hooks.description: IDs of hooks bundled by this plugin. Must reference hook IDs defined in hooks.json indexes.

plugins.description: IDs of other plugins to compose into this plugin. Referenced plugins' primitives are recursively expanded and merged. Circular references are rejected at resolution time.

homepage.description: URL to the plugin's homepage or documentation.

repository.description: URL or identifier for the plugin's source repository.

logo.description: Path or URL to the plugin's logo image.
